_doc: Evidence for finding C1-raw, panel A of the flagship C1 (docs/FLAGSHIP.md), written by bin/py -m places.export. numbers: every number the bundle prints (headline, random-peer and caveat slots, the chart's x, y, bubble, median lines and subject note, the methods page's robustness summary) and every number a precondition reads, each with its kind, formula and the full provenance tuple series_id|year|period|value|footnote|url|sha256|last_modified of every published cell it reads; a rank, count or probability also names the comparison sets it runs over (over), and a probability carries its exact fraction and arithmetic. sets: per specification and axis, the publishable metros' values and series ids; a member's cells are its series at the set's periods. cells and sources: every cell a number or set reads, as cells[file][series id][year|period] = value|footnote, with sources[file] giving url, sha256, Last-Modified and fetched_at, so every key resolves to its full tuple. A registered number (a year) cites the pre-registration instead. preconditions: the table (name, value, threshold, pass) of every clause that prints, all passing; suppressed: each clause that does not print, its reason and its rows. headline, random_peer and caveats are template ids, texts and slots, with the string the slots render to; Atlas renders the sentences. chart: the sidecar's title, subtitle, subject note and label request, each with its template, slots and rule.
